L’organizzazione permette di combinare efficacemente approccio locale e visione d'insieme, garantendo alla popolazione un'offerta ospedaliera globale e di prossimità, indipendentemente dal luogo in cui sono richiesti i servizi. Grazie all'impegno e alla competenza degli oltre 6’500 collaboratori e alla loro attenzione verso la relazione umana, l’EOC assicura un’assistenza sanitaria di qualità prendendosi cura di oltre 41'000 pazienti degenti all'anno e fornendo oltre 600'000 consulti ambulatoriali. descriptionByLocale.en:
Nursing service internship - Ausschreibung The EOC, the multi-site hospital in Ticino, is present with its institutes throughout the entire cantonal territory for a total of 1,000 beds. The organization allows us to effectively combine a local approach and an overall vision, guaranteeing the population a global and local hospital offer, regardless of the place where the services are required. Thanks to the commitment and expertise of over 6,500 collaborators and their attention to human relationships, the EOC ensures quality healthcare by taking care of over 41,000 inpatients per year and providing over 600,000 outpatient consultations. The following position is aimed at candidates who wish to submit a spontaneous application for a nursing service internship. Profile The Nursing Service of the Regional Hospital of Bellinzona and Valli offers the possibility of carrying out different types of internships to those who wish to undertake basic training as a nurse: a) trainee: orientation internship to evaluate a possible enrollment in one of the training courses to obtain the nursing diploma b) stagiaire pre-Supsi: internship required by Supsi for students who wish to undertake a bachelor's degree in nursing c) stagiaire SSSCI: internship required by the SSSCI (Specialised Higher School of Nursing) for students who wish to undertake training as SSS nurses d) medical student: internship required by some Swiss medical faculties to be carried out either before the start of studies or by the end of the 1st year of university training. The availability of internship places depends on the needs of the service.
• Necessary requirements a) practitioner: - intention to undertake professional training in the nursing field - minimum age 16 years of age b) pre-Supsi intern: - registration with SUPSI c) SSSCI intern: - registration with SSSCI d) medical student: - enrollment in the medical faculty of a Swiss university For information on training possibilities, contact the schools (SUPSI or SSSCI). Observations --> The applications of those who do not meet the above requirements will in no case be taken into consideration and will consequently be eliminated from our database.
